Information cutoff: 2026-05-30T07:00:00-04:00. Use only information publicly available at or before this timestamp.

Company: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM)

Strict information cutoff: 2026-05-30T07:00:00-04:00. Use only information publicly available on or before this timestamp.

JPMorgan Chase reports its Card Services business within Consumer & Community Banking mainly as a net revenue rate, with dollar revenue folded into a combined Card Services & Auto line. Reconstruct the Card Services unit economics for fiscal years 2023, 2024 and 2025 and for the first quarters of 2025 and 2026 (through March 31, 2026), using information available at the cutoff.

Give the fixed formula that converts the disclosed rate into Card Services net revenue for a period, including the part-year convention, and the formulas behind the per-card metrics. For each of the five periods, provide:

- the loan balance base the rate applies to, on the basis the company's own rate definition requires (USD millions);
- the net revenue rate (percent);
- net revenue, both annualized and as the amount belonging to the period (USD millions);
- card sales volume (USD billions);
- implied Auto net revenue from the combined line (USD millions).

For the fiscal years only, also give cards in force (millions), net revenue per card and spend per card (USD per card).

Decompose the change in annualized Card Services net revenue between Q1 2025 and Q1 2026 into balance-growth and rate effects, showing any residual, and set out the annualization, averaging, timing and scope adjustments behind your figures.

Submission method (required):
Call `submit_answer` as the final response. In `structured_output`, submit:
- $.formula.net_revenue: The fixed formula translating the disclosed rate and balances into Card Services net revenue, including the part-year convention.
- $.formula.unit_metrics: The formulas behind the per-card unit metrics.
- $.period_rows[].loan_balance_base_usd_m: The Card Services loan balance applied to the rate, USD millions, on the basis the rate definition requires.
- $.period_rows[].net_revenue_rate_pct: The disclosed Card Services net revenue rate for each period, in percent.
- $.period_rows[].net_revenue_annualized_usd_m: Reconstructed Card Services net revenue on the annualized rate basis, USD millions.
- $.period_rows[].net_revenue_period_usd_m: Reconstructed Card Services net revenue belonging to the period itself, USD millions.
- $.period_rows[].sales_volume_usd_b: Card Services card sales volume as disclosed, USD billions.
- $.period_rows[].cards_in_force_m: Cards in force at period end, millions (fiscal years only; null for part-year rows).
- $.period_rows[].revenue_per_card_usd: Annualized net revenue per card in force, USD per card (fiscal years only).
- $.period_rows[].spend_per_card_usd: Card sales volume per card in force, USD per card (fiscal years only).
- $.period_rows[].implied_auto_net_revenue_usd_m: Auto net revenue implied from the combined Card Services & Auto line, USD millions.
- $.quarter_bridge.total_change_usd_m: Total Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 change in annualized net revenue, USD millions.
- $.quarter_bridge.balance_effect_usd_m: Balance-growth effect in the Q1 net revenue bridge, USD millions.
- $.quarter_bridge.rate_effect_usd_m: Revenue-rate effect in the Q1 net revenue bridge, USD millions.
- $.quarter_bridge.interaction_effect_usd_m: Residual cross term of the Q1 net revenue bridge, USD millions.
- $.adjustments: Coverage, timing, annualization and scope adjustments applied in the reconstruction.
Cite at least 2 distinct cutoff-database documents. Include material calculations and any file explicitly required by the question.

rubrics.title: Card Services net revenue formula
rubrics.criterion: JPMorganChase's Card Services net revenue reconstruction multiplies average Card Services loans by the disclosed net revenue rate and sets a three-month amount at one quarter of the annualized result.
rubrics.pass_condition: The submitted net revenue formula applies the rate to the average-loan balance base and converts to part-year amounts by dividing the annualized result by four.

evidence_materials.locator: Q1 2026 Form 10-Q, Glossary - Line of Business Metrics, Consumer & Community Banking (p. 176), definition of Net revenue rate
evidence_materials.excerpt: Represents Card Services net revenue (annualized) expressed as a percentage of average loans for the period.
evidence_materials.supported_claim: The rate's denominator is average loans and its numerator is annualized net revenue, so annualized net revenue equals average Card Services loans multiplied by the rate.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, Card Services Net revenue rate row (p. 67)
evidence_materials.supported_claim: Card Services revenue is disclosed only as a rate, so dollar net revenue must be reconstructed by applying the rate to the matching balance base.

judge.expected_reasoning: The submitted formula should state annualized net revenue = average Card Services loans x net revenue rate and convert a three-month amount by dividing the annualized result by four. Algebraically equivalent presentations pass; applying the rate to anything other than the average-loan base fails.

rubrics.title: Card Services per-card formulas
rubrics.criterion: Net revenue per card for JPMorganChase Card Services equals annualized net revenue divided by cards in force, and card spend per card equals card sales volume divided by the same cards-in-force denominator.
rubrics.pass_condition: The submitted unit-metric formulas divide annualized net revenue and card sales volume by the shared cards-in-force denominator.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, footnote (f) to Cards in force (p. 67)
evidence_materials.excerpt: Represents the total number of open credit cards, inclusive of primary cardholders and authorized users.
evidence_materials.supported_claim: The cards-in-force denominator for per-card metrics is the total open-card count including authorized users.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, Card Services Cards in force row (p. 67)
evidence_materials.supported_claim: Card counts are disclosed at fiscal-year period ends, so the per-card metrics are fiscal-year measures.

judge.expected_reasoning: Net revenue per card = annualized Card Services net revenue / cards in force; spend per card = card sales volume / cards in force. Both use the same disclosed open-card count, with annualized revenue for a per-year metric. Equivalent wording passes.

rubrics.title: Card Services reconstruction scope adjustments
rubrics.criterion: The reconstruction adjustments record the scope choices behind the JPMorganChase Card Services figures, including that card sales volume excludes commercial card and that Auto revenue is the residual of the combined Card Services & Auto line.
rubrics.pass_condition: The adjustments state both the excluding-commercial-card sales-volume scope and the residual derivation of implied Auto revenue from the combined line.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, Card Services Sales volume, excluding commercial card row (p. 67)
evidence_materials.supported_claim: Card Services sales volume is defined on a scope that excludes commercial card.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Revenue by business, Card Services & Auto row (p. 65)
evidence_materials.supported_claim: Card Services and Auto share one revenue line, so implied Auto revenue is the residual after removing reconstructed Card Services net revenue.

judge.expected_reasoning: The adjustments should acknowledge that card sales volume excludes commercial card and that implied Auto revenue is the combined Card Services & Auto line minus reconstructed Card Services net revenue on a matching period basis. Equivalent wording passes.

rubrics.pass_condition: The submission includes a cutoff-valid passage defining cards in force as open credit cards inclusive of authorized users, or an equivalent definition of the per-card denominator.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, footnote (f) to Cards in force (p. 67)
evidence_materials.excerpt: Represents the total number of open credit cards, inclusive of primary cardholders and authorized users.
evidence_materials.supported_claim: The cards-in-force count, used as the per-card denominator, covers open credit cards inclusive of primary cardholders and authorized users.

evidence_materials.locator: 2025 Form 10-K, Consumer & Community Banking Selected metrics, Cards in force (in millions) (f) row (p. 67)
evidence_materials.supported_claim: Period-end card counts for the FY2023-FY2025 per-card metrics are disclosed in millions.

judge.expected_reasoning: Per-card metrics divide by the disclosed cards-in-force count; a submission evidencing that count or an equivalent open-card definition passes, while unsupported denominators such as accounts or customers fail.

rubrics.title: Card sales volume scope evidence
rubrics.criterion: The card sales volume used in JPMorganChase's Card Services reconstruction for FY2023-Q1 2026, measured in USD billions, is supported as the company's series excluding commercial card rather than the wider Consumer & Community Banking debit-and-credit card sales volume.

rubrics.title: Combined-line Auto residual evidence
rubrics.criterion: Across FY2023-Q1 2026, the implied Auto net revenue in JPMorganChase's Consumer & Community Banking reconstruction, measured in USD millions, is supported as the residual of the combined Card Services & Auto revenue line after deducting the reconstructed Card Services net revenue.
rubrics.pass_condition: The submission's evidence includes the combined Card Services & Auto revenue line for the reconstructed periods, or an equivalent passage showing the Auto figure is derived as its residual.

rubrics.title: Q1 bridge rate effect
rubrics.criterion: The rate effect in JPMorganChase's Q1 2026 versus Q1 2025 Card Services net revenue bridge, measured in USD millions, reflects the increase in the net revenue rate between the two first quarters and is approximately USD 898 million.
rubrics.pass_condition: The rate effect reported in the submitted bridge is within 7 percent of USD 898 million.
